x: Eddie Short lost a shoe but pluckily kept going and Archie Bedford came through to finish a good fourth. Jack Shields and Ken England were also well up and a new member in J.
Mick Porter and Lew Bush also ran well as did J.H.Braggington, who is a first season runner over the country.
Jack Braggington was third in the 3 miles run which was won in a new record time, while in the Junior events we had D.G.McLean 2nd in the 1 mile with Ray Tooby, now in the Army, finishing 3rd.
